subject: SAM3 + Encord
text:

Quick update: Encord just enabled SAM3 auto-segmentation with text prompts.
For your team at [COMPANY], this means you can play video natively in Encord and

subject: Data Curation for SPSA
text:

subject: post RSNA catch up
text:
Hi [NAME],

Just checked and results you were at RSNA - I missed you there somehow. I
wanted to reach out and ask if you'd be interested in grabbing a coffee
(now a virtual one).

I work with a bunch of med AI companies in the mammography space providing
a solution around coordinating multi-reader annotation and QC across ML
engineers and clinical experts. We address this with built-in
consensus/adjudication workflows, structured review stages, and role-based
access controls. Our hierarchical ontology builder ensures consistent,
context-rich labelling across studies (and we offer services too).

Happy to share updates from our recent projects with Curemetrix, Viz.ai
<[LINK]> or Highmark Health - would it make sense to connect next
week?

text:
